name: roop-monorepo
description: ROOP runtime and VS Code tooling

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:extension
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=@your-org/roop-runtime run lint && npm --workspace=roop-language-support run lint
scripts.format: npm --workspace=@your-org/roop-runtime run format && npm --workspace=roop-language-support run format
scripts.clean: npm --workspace=@your-org/roop-runtime run clean && npm --workspace=roop-language-support run clean
scripts.dev: npm run build && echo 'Launch VS Code with --extensionDevelopmentPath=packages/roop-vscode'
